limitations: No atomic observation across signals, pending state, filesystem bytes and exit.
Direct third-party signals arriving after the last finite pending scan can be unobserved; legitimate requests are not redefined out of scope.
Executor-recorded forwarded cancellation after inner D rejects independently; persistent lease/input mutations reject by outer checks.
Transient cancel-and-revert/input-change-and-revert between samples is not guaranteed observable.
POSIX spawn/registration race requires fail-closed ownership evidence and bounded cleanup; unknown ownership cannot be accepted.
OS scheduling or uninterruptible kernel work can delay kill/reap; missing bound is failure, not an extension.
Thirty-second finalization allocations are not measured future artifact throughput guarantees.
Torch/native/MPS restoration, entry determinism, runtime resource behavior, gameplay/training and qualification are untested.
